plan.notes: Source: 'BA/MAT History/Political Science: Political Science Education 4+1 Program - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of History), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. 4+1 program: 108 undergraduate + 30 graduate hours = 138 total. Graduate MAT courses are sequenced alongside undergraduate courses. Semester 7 is labeled 'Fall - Semester 7' with the annotation 'Conditional or Unconditional Admission to the EPP' - the annotation is noted here and the label is kept. The Summer row prints 'MAT 5083 Creating Environments for Learning  3  3' (a duplicate trailing credit) - credits kept as 3. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true.
